description: Publish markdown at a public docs-md.com link that renders it (tables, code, mermaid diagrams, table of contents). Use it to send a plan, spec, report, README or agent handoff to a person or another agent. Returns the URL, a raw-markdown URL and an edit token for later updates or deletion.

content.description: The markdown content to share (up to 120,000 characters)

expiry.description: How long the link stays live (default 30d; "never" keeps it forever)

filename.description: Optional file name shown as the page title, e.g. "HANDOFF.md" or "plan.md"

name: share_markdown
title: Share Markdown
